data.name: Acid Blood Stain
data.description: Your acidic sweat damages your equipment. After using or wearing an item for 8 hours total, it gains the broken condition. If you use or wear a broken item for 8 hours, it is destroyed. This ability doesn't break cursed items, artifacts, or similar items that are difficult or impossible to destroy.
